title: Do the math: How we took over ChatGPT accounts
hook_text: Researchers hijacked ChatGPT accounts using math
script:
Security researchers at Parameter discovered a critical flaw that let them take over ChatGPT accounts.
The attack abused the way MathLive parses formulas inside chat inputs.
Researchers bypassed the sandbox environment using cross-frame messaging vulnerabilities.
This trick allowed malicious code to execute inside the OpenAI web application.
Parameter privately disclosed the bug to OpenAI before publishing their technical analysis.
OpenAI deployed a security patch to fix the sandbox bypass.
Would you trust an AI assistant with sensitive personal data after this?
